item.title: Prosperity at Risk: Flood Exposure and Wealth in Asia and the Pacific
item.description: Each year, floods drive millions of families across Asia and the Pacific from their homes—and often push them deeper into poverty.

item.title: Mapping Flood Risk and Economic Impacts in Egypt’s Coastal Cities
item.description: Coastal cities in Egypt face growing risks from both coastal flooding linked to sea-level rise and pluvial flooding caused by intense rainfall.
